title: Sparse Fourier hypothesis from coefficients
statement: Given a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a rational coefficient assigned to each member of $\mathcal F$, the resulting sparse Fourier hypothesis has support $\mathcal F$ and those assigned coefficients.
hypotheses_covered: A finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates
A rational coefficient for each member of the family
